symptom: A research-only session receive() helper set admitted=True before evaluating return payload.decode(ASCII). An invalid non-ASCII frame raised UnicodeDecodeError after the ownership flag had already been set; the receive-local finally skipped close, leaving the SCM_RIGHTS FD live before process exit. A disposable Linux reproduction observed fstat succeed on the leaked FD, then explicitly closed it. Moving decode before admitted=True and adding an invalid-frame EBADF regression fixed the synthetic fixture. No production defect is claimed.
lesson: An ownership handoff flag must not be set before any fallible expression that prepares the return value. Even with receive-local finally cleanup, return payload.decode(...) can throw after admitted=True and leak an SCM_RIGHTS descriptor. Decode and validate while the helper still owns all received FDs; transfer ownership only immediately before a non-throwing return.
guardrail: In research-only SCM_RIGHTS receivers, parse and validate ancillary FDs, decode frame bytes, and prepare the complete return value inside the receive-local ownership scope. Mark admitted only after all fallible work completes; on any denial or decode error close every received FD and verify EBADF before process exit. Reuse LEARN-forward-vault-scm-rights-prehandoff-fd-leak-20261028 and Python String.raw/output-flag guardrails.
